name: African Market OS — Minimum Viable Relationships (MVR) API
description:
The MVR API measures trust, belonging, permission, and embeddedness to determine
relational readiness for ventures and initiatives entering high-context markets.
Public spec describes endpoints, request/response shapes, and integration guidance.
Based on the MVR Framework v3.0.6 (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.17310446).
